Lifts slow near harbour, print room, loading bay, garden studio, and east wing. Coffee machines in north office, harbour room, and garden studio working. Umbrellas left in harbour, loading bay, garden studio, east wing.
- Temperature complaints: Bram, Ada, Wren, Ines, Rafe, Finn, Opal, Pia, Jonah, Esme report cold. Dell thinks east wing too cold in evening.
